plan.title: Change Map Product Docs and Map Engineering Docs icons to green play button
plan.overview: Update DocsActionItem class to support optional ThemeColor parameter, then change both "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs" instantiations to use green play button icons. This follows the existing ActionItem pattern from tasks-view.capability.ts which uses ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green')) for primary executable actions.

approach.rationale:
Following the established pattern for primary action icons: - ActionItem class at tasks-view.capability.ts:188-190 uses ThemeIcon('play', ThemeColor('charts.green')) - This visual language communicates "executable command" to users - The change aligns docs action items with task action items for consistency
The DocsActionItem constructor currently accepts only iconName (string) and creates ThemeIcon(iconName) without color support. We need to add an optional ThemeColor parameter to enable colored icons while maintaining backwards compatibility for the class signature.
approach.breaking-changes: None - constructor signature change is additive (optional parameter)
